About the project

  • In Cyclad we work with top international IT companies in order to boost their potential in delivering outstanding, cutting-edge technologies that shape the world of the future. We are seeking an Experienced AI Engineer with strong consulting and delivery capabilities. Responsible for the technical design, implementation, and scaling of AI-driven automation use cases across the entire development lifecycle.
  • Project information:
  • Type of project: IT Services
  • Office location: Warsaw
  • Work model: hybrid – max. 2 days per week in the office/ 3 remote
  • Budget: 140 - 160 PLN net/ h - b2b
  • Only candidates with citizenship in the European Union and residence in Poland
  • Start date: ASAP

This is how we organize our work

This is how we work

  • at the client's site
  • agile

Your responsibilities

  • Lead the technical implementation of AI and GenAI use cases.
  • Design and develop production-ready AI solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with architecture, quality, and operational standards.
  • Coach and provide technical leadership to AI Engineers.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for clients, Product Owners, and project management teams.

Our requirements

  • Several years of experience in the development and operationalization of AI and GenAI solutions.
  • Strong expertise in LLMs, Agentic AI, and AI platforms.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and deploying AI workflows using n8n and/or Otera.
  • Experience with API integration, data connectivity, and automation solutions.
  • Experience working in cloud environments (e.g., Google Cloud, Azure, or AWS).
  • Experience in designing solution architectures to support use case planning and implementation.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) in software development.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, security, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.
  • Very good English skills
